articles.headline_english: Flood relief should be provided immediately
articles.content_english: Flood compensation must be provided immediately. During the census conducted in January, partial damage was found in some areas in Kuzzumala in July and August. After assessing the balance and finalizing the report, the farmers are to be provided compensation promptly. In the meeting held in Muthai Kasil in January, it was decided that institutions like Sho Aero should facilitate the disbursement immediately. (Simiegenon) (Walasioa)
